prompt: Create an original 60 second Indian acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: sitar, bansuri, tabla, tanpura. Style: gradually unfolding modal melody and intricate tabla. Tempo approximately 82 BPM; D major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A traditional instrumental piece featuring a prominent wind instrument melody, likely a shehnai or similar, over a rhythmic percussion and drone-like string accompaniment. The music evokes a meditative and calm atmosphere with an exotic, possibly Indian, feel.
description.zh: 一段传统器乐作品，以突出的管乐器（可能是唢呐或类似乐器）旋律为主，伴随着有节奏的打击乐和持续的弦乐伴奏。音乐营造出一种冥想而平静的氛围，带有异域风情，可能源自印度。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
